name: codegraph
description: Local semantic code intelligence for VS Code: native-accelerated runtime, MCP, impact analysis, affected tests, workflow graphs, and read-only AI review.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: CodeGraph executes its bundled local runtime and reads workspace source files.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The local CodeGraph runtime requires a filesystem-backed workspace.

chatParticipants.name: codegraph
chatParticipants.description: Explain workflows or review code with CodeGraph context.

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain purpose, functions, and workflow; create a Markdown report with a Mermaid preview.

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review changed or selected code, analyze blast radius, and classify risk without editing.

commands.name: impact
commands.description: Analyze change impact, detect affected tests, classify risk, and report estimated token savings.

disambiguation.description: Explains what code does, why it exists, and how control or data flows through functions.
examples: What is this function used for?
How does this request workflow work?
Explain the purpose of the selected code.

disambiguation.description: Reviews code changes and evaluates affected callers, dependencies, regressions, and risk.
examples: What can break if I change this?
Assess the risk of this diff.

disambiguation.description: Traces changed files through dependent workflows and identifies the indexed tests that should run.
examples: Which tests are affected by my changes?
Phân tích ảnh hưởng của thay đổi này.

commands.title: CodeGraph: Export Latest Report as Markdown
CodeGraph: Export Latest Report as PDF

codegraph.autoRefresh.enabled.description: Keep the index fresh with CodeGraph's native watcher while the bundled MCP runtime is active.

codegraph.autoRefresh.debounceMs.description: Quiet period before a burst of file changes is incrementally synced.

codegraph.chat.maxContextFiles.description: Maximum number of source files returned by CodeGraph for a chat report.

codegraph.chat.maxDiffCharacters.description: Maximum Git diff size supplied to /review. Larger diffs are truncated with an explicit warning.

codegraph.impact.maxDepth.description: Maximum dependency depth for affected-test detection.

codegraph.metrics.enabled.description: Store workspace-local estimates of context tokens and file reads saved by impact analysis.

codegraph.reports.openPreview.description: Automatically open generated Markdown reports in VS Code's preview.

scripts.build: npm run check && npm run bundle
scripts.build:all: npm run build:runtime && npm run build
